lines: Initiation manifold this ending in śrāddha which is declared; that for purification, for liberation, for enjoyment also, for both or.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dīkṣā bahuprakāreyaṃ śrāddhāntā yā prakīrtitā sā saṃskriyāyai mokṣāya bhogāyāpi dvayāya vā
